name: thaliris
description: Thaliris context orchestration for Claude Code: a Controller skill, fresh role subagents, and hooks that bind native agent identity and evidence continuity to the shared Thaliris Core (vendored; needs only Python 3.11+).

default_execution_mode.title: Default Thaliris execution mode
default_execution_mode.description: How managed project tasks run unless you say otherwise for a task. delegated: Claude hands investigation, implementation and review to fresh thaliris:* subagents (choosing this is your standing request for those subagents; it uses more of your plan's usage). controller-direct: Claude works in the main session and uses subagents only when you ask. single-agent: no Thaliris subagents.

auto_approve_runner.title: Run the Thaliris runner without permission prompts
auto_approve_runner.description: When on, Thaliris' hook approves its own runner command (only a single direct invocation of this plugin's CLI, never anything chained to it), so managed tasks do not stop to ask. In plan mode only read-only runner commands are approved. Other commands keep your normal permission rules.

model_selection.title: Who chooses each role's model
model_selection.description: controller: the Controller chooses the model of every Thaliris role per dispatch as the work requires, after division of labor (e.g. haiku for Git closure and CI observation, sonnet for clear local work, opus for coupled or unclear work); choosing this is your request that it set the model. role-defaults: each role uses its default model unless you ask for another.
